findings.summary: The production half of the repair is unguarded: the added tests build prompt_context themselves (test_refine_docs_prompt.py:220-256) and the pipeline tests patch render_prompt to a constant (test_refine_docs_settled_wording.py:58-63), so reverting lines 124-127 leaves the entire suite green and the defect recurs silently until the next escalation call.

The base-red log's header names its tree as a bare git archive a084551a5, but the run collected 17 items where that revision defines 14 in that file and the three added tests exist only from 6b9487535, so the arm cannot be reproduced from the record.

The settled-wording block is a verbatim copy of generate_docs_user.md:22-38 where this directory already carries partials (_conventions.md is included by both templates), and drift between two copies is the shape of the defect being repaired.

accepted_first_pass 7 and unsettled_at_the_bound 2 cannot both be read from the ten-row table, which shows six accepted, one drafted, two refining and one exhausted, so one row is double counted and beta is in no count.

The unit-misfit class rate 0.1098 is one recorded observation presented as a two-name mean, since electron_number_density carries spend_usd null, and notes_on_rate documents that gap for family parent only.

The base and after gate results were read from the reviewed run's own gate logs, whose headers name their trees and whose last lines read EXIT=1 and EXIT=0; the base arm's two red ids are test_renders_settled_shared_wording and test_shared_parts_built_for_species_density, which are the tests the repair adds.
